cues.en: As an exercise, try modifying ContentKNNRecommender.py to use genre, release year, and mise en scene data independently.
cues.zh: 練習修改 ContentKNNRecommender.py，分別單獨使用類型、上映年份與場面調度資料。

cues.en: Which produces the best accuracy, and which produces the most satisfying results subjectively to you?
cues.zh: 哪一種準確程度最好？哪一種在主觀上，讓你覺得結果最滿意？

cues.en: If you have lots of time, you can pass True into the Evaluate function in ContentRecs.py to compute more evaluation metrics to work with.
cues.zh: 如果有很多時間，可以在 ContentRecs.py 的 Evaluate 函數中傳入 True，計算更多評估指標。

cues.en: I'll go over my results in the next slide, so hit Pause if you don't want any spoilers.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片會說明我的結果，如果不想被劇透，先暫停。

cues.en: Here are the results I got by trying each content attribute out independently.
cues.zh: 這是分別單獨測試每個內容屬性後，我得到的結果。

cues.en: As far as accuracy goes, genre is the winner, and qualitatively, I think genre is the winner as well.
cues.zh: 以準確程度來說，類型勝出；從品質角度，我也認為類型最好。

cues.en: You can see that release year just ended up finding the year this user liked films from the best, and recommended whatever it could find from that year.
cues.zh: 可以看到，上映年份最後只是找出這位使用者最喜歡哪一年的電影，再推薦所有能找到的那一年電影。

cues.en: Since we only have release dates down to the year level, what really happened here is every movie from 1994 was tied for first place, so it's kind of arbitrary which ones made it into the top 10 recommendations.
cues.zh: 由於上映日期只有年份精度，實際上所有 1994 年電影都並列第一，因此哪些進入前十名，有點隨機。

cues.en: That doesn't make for good recommendations.
cues.zh: 這無法產生好的推薦。

cues.en: Mise en scene turned up some really obscure stuff, much of it foreign.
cues.zh: 場面調度找出一些非常冷門的東西，很多是外國片。

cues.en: It's possible that this user actually would enjoy foreign films.
cues.zh: 這位使用者確實有可能喜歡外國片。

cues.en: I only recognize a couple of these, but they are ones I liked personally.
cues.zh: 我只認得其中幾部，但都是我自己喜歡的。

cues.en: Again, it's dangerous to project your own tastes onto somebody else's recommendation results, but I purposely chose our test user as someone who has similar tastes to my own, based on their rating history,
cues.zh: 再次強調，把自己的品味投射到別人的推薦結果上，很危險；但我刻意根據評分歷史，選了一位與自己品味相近的測試使用者，

cues.en: so I can get a qualitative feel of the quality of the results they are getting.
cues.zh: 以便從品質角度，感受結果的好壞。

cues.en: None of these are particularly exciting on their own, although I'd say genre is a clear winner.
cues.zh: 單獨使用時，沒有哪種特別令人興奮，不過我會說類型明顯勝出。

cues.en: But combining these attributes together leads to more interesting results, and that's true in general.
cues.zh: 但把這些屬性組合起來，就有更有意思的結果，通常也是如此。

cues.en: The most successful recommender systems are the ones that combine many sources of data, and even many different algorithms, to produce a system that is more than just the sum of its parts.
cues.zh: 最成功的推薦系統，會結合多個資料來源，甚至多種不同演算法，產生超越各部分單純相加的效果。

cues.en: How would you go about making these results even better based on what you've learned so far?
cues.zh: 根據目前所學，你會如何進一步改善結果？

cues.en: Well, we do have popularity ranking data handy.
cues.zh: 我們手上確實有熱門排名資料。

cues.en: It would be tempting to use popularity, at least as a tie-breaker.
cues.zh: 很想把熱門程度用進來，至少作為同分時的決勝條件。

cues.en: I bet the release year-based recommendations would be a lot better if we had a secondary sort based on popularity, for example.
cues.zh: 例如，如果對上映年份推薦加上熱門程度的次要排序，我想會好得多。

cues.en: If you're up for more of a challenge, try that out.
cues.zh: 如果想挑戰更多，就試試看。

cues.en: See if you improve the release year-based recommendations by sorting the k nearest neighbors within a given year by popularity.
cues.zh: 將同一年中的 k 個最近鄰，依熱門程度排序，看看能否改善上映年份推薦。

cues.en: That's what developing recommender systems is all about; just trying new ideas and seeing what works for your specific users and items that you're working with.
cues.zh: 開發推薦系統就是這樣，不斷嘗試新想法，找出對特定使用者與項目有效的方式。

cues.en: It's never a one size fits all sort of thing.
cues.zh: 從來沒有一體適用的方法。

cues.en: Don't go to the next slide until you're ready to see a spoiler of how I sorted those year-based recommendations by popularity as a secondary sort.
cues.zh: 準備好看我如何依熱門程度，為年份推薦加入次要排序之前，不要到下一張投影片。

cues.en: The first thing I did was go back into ContentKNNAlgorithm.py and modify it to only use release years as a criterion.
cues.zh: 首先，回到 ContentKNNAlgorithm.py，修改成只使用上映年份作為依據。

cues.en: Don't forget that or you'll waste a lot of time.
cues.zh: 別忘了，否則會浪費很多時間。

cues.en: So to have a secondary sort in your top-N results, all we need to do is modify the SampleTopNRecs function in Evaluator.py, which is where we are displaying our top-N recommendations in our test framework.
cues.zh: 要在 Top-N 結果中加入次要排序，只要修改 Evaluator.py 的 SampleTopNRecs 函數，測試框架就是在這裡顯示 Top-N 推薦。

cues.en: We already have the MovieLens data available to this function, so we can extract popularity data for each recommendation candidate while we're building up the list of them.
cues.zh: 這個函數已經能取得 MovieLens 資料，因此建立候選清單時，也能擷取每個推薦候選項目的熱門資料。

cues.en: You can see that in your recommendations.append call here.
cues.zh: 可以在這裡的 recommendations.append 呼叫看到。

cues.en: Then to do the secondary sort, we first sort the list by popularity, so the most popular items are at the top of the list.
cues.zh: 接著，為了做次要排序，先按熱門程度排序清單，讓最熱門的項目排在最前面。

cues.en: This happens to be in element number two of our recommendation tuples.
cues.zh: 這個資料剛好在推薦 tuple 的索引二。

cues.en: Then we can sort by element one, which is the estimated rating.
cues.zh: 再按索引一，也就是預測評分排序。

cues.en: If we have a tie when ranking based on estimated ratings, the original sort by popularity will still be in place from before.
cues.zh: 如果預測評分相同，先前依熱門程度排好的順序，仍會保留。

cues.en: There are other ways to do a secondary sort in Python, but it gets tricky when you need to sort things in different directions, so we'll go with this approach.
cues.zh: Python 還有其他次要排序方式，但需要以不同方向排序時會變複雜，因此使用這個方法。

cues.en: The recommendations we end up with are perhaps a little better.
cues.zh: 最後得到的推薦，也許好一點。

cues.en: Honestly, 1994 didn't have many blockbuster movies, and this user already rated most of them.
cues.zh: 老實說，1994 年沒有很多賣座大片，而且這位使用者大部分都已經評分過。

cues.en: But these results are a little more recognizable than the ones we started with, and some really obscure titles have been dropped from them.
cues.zh: 不過，這些結果比一開始更容易辨認，也排除了一些非常冷門的片名。

cues.en: Now, by using popularity data, technically we're no longer limiting our recommendations to content attributes.
cues.zh: 現在用了熱門程度資料，嚴格來說，推薦就不再只根據內容屬性。

cues.en: Popularity is behavior-based data.
cues.zh: 熱門程度是行為資料。

cues.en: But the point of this exercise is to not be limited by the buckets different algorithms and approaches present.
cues.zh: 但這個練習的重點，就是不要被不同演算法與方法的分類框住。

cues.en: Always be willing to experiment with new ideas and ways of combining different ideas.
cues.zh: 永遠願意實驗新想法，以及結合不同想法的方式。

cues.en: That's where real innovation comes from, and in this case, it made our results a little bit better.
cues.zh: 真正的創新來自這裡，而這個例子中，它讓結果稍微變好了。
